# Gold Scalpers EA

> Gold Scalpers EA is an automated MetaTrader 5 (MT5) Expert Advisor — a pure XAUUSD (gold) M5 scalper. It trades hands-free using a Slope Direction Line × 50 EMA crossover confirmed by the ZeroLag MACD, with prop-firm-ready risk controls. Price: $220 one-time (lifetime license), 30-day money-back.

Gold Scalpers EA is a rules-based gold-trading robot for MetaTrader 5. It enters when the Slope Direction Line crosses the 50 EMA (slope up through the EMA = buy, down = sell), confirmed by the ZeroLag MACD being on the correct side of zero plus an optional confirmation candle. The stop loss sits at the most recent swing high/low beyond the 50 EMA (real market structure); break-even protection then moves it to entry once the trade is in profit so a winner cannot become a loser. Momentum Pyramiding optionally adds to a WINNING trade as it runs - never averaging down - and every add-on shares one basket stop, tightened by a step-stop on each fill. Risk is capped by daily profit/loss limits, a max-drawdown guard, a position cap, a chop/whipsaw filter, a loss-streak cooldown, and spread/session/news filters. Pyramiding can be turned off for prop-firm single-entry mode. A live on-chart dashboard shows status, a signal-readiness bar, BUY/SELL arrows and P&L; alerts are delivered by pop-up, mobile push and Telegram.

## Key facts
- Platform: MetaTrader 5 (MT5), works on any broker
- Market: XAUUSD (gold) only, M5 timeframe
- Strategy: Slope Direction Line × 50 EMA crossover + ZeroLag MACD confirmation + optional confirmation candle
- Stop-loss: swing-structure stop (last swing high/low beyond the 50 EMA) + break-even lock + step-stop trailing
- Take-profit: quick scalping target; optional Momentum Pyramiding adds to winners only
- Break-even: stop moves to entry + a locked amount once the trade is in profit
- Prop-Firm Mode: percentage daily-loss and max-drawdown limits from balance baselines, hard lock on breach
- Pre-flight self-check on attach (permissions, history, spread, indicators, licence)
- Risk controls: daily loss/profit limits, max-drawdown guard, max daily orders, spread/session/news filters
- Price: $220 one-time, lifetime license (regular $297)
- Guarantee: 30-day money-back
- License: bound to the buyer's MT5 account number (allow-list at https://goldscalpers.com/licenses.txt)
- Not martingale; optional Momentum Pyramiding that can be turned off for prop-firm single-entry mode
